verdict.rationale: API versioning and deprecation policy is a fair question for a cloud developer platform, so the axis applies. The pack has no documented API versioning scheme and no deprecation policy. The published OpenAPI spec and Worker deployment rollbacks are adjacent features: rollbacks cover versions of the user's own code, not versioning of Cloudflare's APIs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
